intro-1.text: How LuchoAI works. Your football coach for ages 8 to 18.

start-1.text: Open LuchoAI and tap Get started.

step1-1.text: Step 1: Switch on your AI coach.

step1-2.text: A grown-up picks an AI company.

step1-3.text: Then pastes in the AI key. It stays on this device.

step2-2.text: Answer five quick questions about you.

step2-3.text: Done! Now pick what to do first.

step3-2.text: Ask your coach anything about football.

step3-3.text: Your coach answers, just for you.

step3-4.text: Make a training plan for your week.

step3-5.text: Save it, and see how to set up each drill.

step4-1.text: Step 4: Play, think and check in.

step4-2.text: New games to play every Monday.

step4-3.text: Game IQ: drag yourself to the best spot.

step4-5.text: Check in with how you feel.

step4-6.text: It stays on this device, just for you.

outro-1.text: You're ready to play! Tap Get started to switch on your coach and make your profile. Games and Wellbeing work without an AI key.
